The '''Armed Forces Medical Science Journal''' was a medical publication issued by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. [[Elara Dorne]] wrote an article for the Journal detailing a simplified step-by-step process for quickly assessing wounds and treatment options in combat.<ref name="Submitted for Approval" />
